newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian kid drives truck into pit, six dead.
newsitem.headline: Colombian kid drives truck into pit, six dead.

text.p: A truck driven by a 10-year-old boy plunged into a pit filled with water, killing him and five other children in central Colombia, police said on Saturday.
The accident happened on Friday afternoon near the town of Turmeque, in Boyaca province, after the boy's father let him take the wheel of his Nissan truck.
The youngster lost control as he rounded a bend in a dirt track and the truck fell into the pit, police said.
The children drowned in 15 feet (five meters) of water, police said. They included the boy's sister, two brothers and two cousins, all aged between 7-16.
The father and uncle of the dead children, Alvaro Naranjo, survived but suffered head injuries.

"I let him drive because he had done so before and I had full confidence in him," a tearful Naranjo told the NTC TV news programme. "I don't know how I'll ever get over this loss, I was just unable to save any of them."
